user.title: Welcome to Home Modes (1 of 3)
user.description:
Home Modes gives your home one mode, such as Home, Night or Away, that automations and dashboards can follow.

Pick the modes to start with. You can rename, add or turn off modes later.

people.title: Who lives here? (2 of 3)
people.description:
Pick the people whose phones tell Home Modes whether someone is home. When everybody has left, the mode switches to Away; when someone comes back, to Home.

Leave it empty to switch Away and Home yourself. You can change this later.

data_description.away_delay_min: Minutes everybody must be gone, so a quick walk to the mailbox does not count.

schedule.title: Night and morning (3 of 3)
schedule.description:
Home Modes can switch to Night in the evening and end Night in the morning, by the clock.

Leave it off to switch Night yourself. Later you can also use sleep sensors, phone charging, motion or your phone's alarm (Options → Automatic switching).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Modes Advanced is already set up. Only one household is supported.

error.same_time: Night and morning must be at different times.

automation.title: Automatic switching
automation.description:
{summary}

Nothing switches by itself until you set it up here. When someone picks a mode by hand, that choice wins for a while (see « Manual changes »).

menu_options.override: Manual changes: how long they win

edit_role.title: Choose a mode
edit_role.description: Pick the mode to rename or turn on/off, or « Back ».

data_description.name: Shown on cards and in the mode selector. Must be unique.
data_description.enabled: A mode that is off disappears everywhere. At least one main mode (Home, Night, Away, Vacation or your own) must stay on.

move_role.title: Change the order
move_role.description:
Current order: {order}.

Pick a mode and a direction, or « Back ».

add_custom.title: Add a custom mode
add_custom.description: For example Cinema or Cleaning. Leave the name empty to go back.

remove_custom.title: Remove a custom mode
remove_custom.description: The mode and its entities are removed. Pick « Back » to keep everything.

presence.title: Presence: Away and Home
presence.description:
When all people below have left, the mode switches to Away after the waiting time. When the first one comes back, it switches to Home.

Leave the list empty to never switch by presence. A person whose location is unknown never causes a switch.

data_description.away_delay_min: Minutes everybody must be gone, so a quick walk does not count.
data_description.vacation_after_h: Hours everybody stays away before the mode switches to Vacation (only when the Vacation mode is on).

night.title: Night methods
night.description: How does Home Modes know it is night? Pick one or more ways: the first one that happens switches to Night. Pick only « By hand only » to never switch automatically.

data_description.methods: « By hand only » cannot be combined with the others.
data_description.start: Used by « At a set time », starts the window for phone charging, and ends the morning motion window.
data_description.sleep_sensors: Only used by the sleep sensors method. Binary sensors or input booleans that turn on when someone goes to sleep (for example bed occupancy or a sleep-mode toggle).
data_description.charging_sensors: Only used by the phone charging method. Lists charging binary sensors and Companion app sensors (pick the Battery state sensor of a phone).
data_description.end: Phone charging only counts between the evening start and this time.

morning.title: Morning methods
morning.description: How does Home Modes know Night is over? Pick one or more ways: the first one that happens ends Night. Pick only « By hand only » to never end Night automatically.

data_description.methods: « By hand only » cannot be combined with the others.
data_description.time: Only used by « At a set time ».
data_description.earliest: Only used by « When there is motion »: motion before this time is ignored.
data_description.motion_sensors: Only used by the motion method. Lists motion, occupancy and presence sensors.
data_description.alarm_sensors: Only used by the next alarm method. Timestamp sensors such as the Companion app Next alarm sensor.

override.title: Manual changes
override.description: When someone picks a mode by hand, automatic switching is paused so it does not undo that choice right away. Choose when automatic switching takes over again.

data_description.duration_min: Only used with « After a set time ».

user_rules.title: Guests and restricted users
user_rules.description:
Limit which modes a user may pick, for example a guest account. Administrators can always pick every mode and are not listed ({count} users can be limited).

Pick a user, or « Back ».

menu_options.actions: Run actions when a mode starts or ends
menu_options.vacation: Vacation lights (look like someone is home)

actions.title: Enter and exit actions
actions.description:
Run your own actions when a mode starts (enter) or ends (exit), for example turn off all lights when Away starts. Pick the mode, or « Back ».

A slow or failing action never blocks the mode change; it is stopped after the timeout below (saved either way).

actions_edit.title: Actions of {role}
actions_edit.description: Exit actions run just before the mode changes, enter actions right after. Templates can use to_name, from_name, to_role, from_role, user_id and more (see the Configuration page in the documentation).

alarmo.title: Alarmo bridge
alarmo.description:
Optional and off by default. Home Modes only talks to Alarmo's entity and services, and works normally when Alarmo is missing.

No alarm code is ever stored. If Alarmo requires a code to arm or disarm, the bridge reports an error instead of acting; turn the code requirement off in Alarmo for the bridge to work.

Turn this on only when presence-based arming/disarming in the Ring Keypad blueprint is off, otherwise both would act on the alarm.

data.apply_auto: Apply automatic mode changes to Alarmo

data_description.entity_id: Leave empty to use the only Alarmo alarm panel.
data_description.apply_auto: Off by default. When on, changes made by schedules, sensors, presence and temporary-mode expiry may arm Alarmo (and disarm it where a mapping allows it).

alarmo_map.title: Alarmo state {step}/{total}: {state}
alarmo_map.description: Map this Alarmo state to a Home Modes mode. Leave the mode empty and the switches off to not map it. Each screen is saved when you submit it.

data.to_alarmo: Mode change sets this Alarmo state

alarmo_map_disarmed.title: Alarmo state {step}/{total}: {state}
alarmo_map_disarmed.description: WARNING: switching to this mode would DISARM your alarm. This never happens unless 'Allow disarming Alarmo' is on, is never done for allow-list users, and never for automatic changes unless they are enabled on the previous screen. Leave it off unless you fully understand the risk.

data.to_alarmo: Mode change sets this Alarmo state

vacation.title: Vacation lights
vacation.description: While the chosen modes are active, the chosen lights go on and off in the evening so the house looks lived in. Only these lights are touched. The history shows when it starts and stops.

data.roles: Run while this mode is active

data_description.strategy: Replay copies last week's same weekday from the recorder and falls back to random if there is no history.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Get a message when the mode changes, when someone is refused, and more. Nothing is sent until you add a rule.

notify_add.title: Add a notification rule
notify_add.description: When should the notification be sent? Pick « Back » to add nothing.

notify_test.title: Send a test notification
notify_test.description:
Pick a rule and press Submit: every target of that rule gets a test message with the rule's channel and priority (the duplicate rate limit does not apply). You stay on this screen to see the result; pick « Back » to leave.

{result}

notify_remove.title: Remove a rule
notify_remove.description: Pick the rule to remove. Pick « Back » to return without changes.

notify_settings.title: Duplicate protection
notify_settings.description: The same message is not sent to the same target twice within this time. 0 turns it off.

history.title: History log
history.description: The history log keeps the latest mode changes, refused attempts and system events. Older entries are dropped.

import_input_select.title: Import from an old input_select
import_input_select.description: Choose the input_select that holds your old house mode. Nothing is written yet; the next steps only show suggestions and a preview. Leave it empty to go back.

import_map.title: Map the options
import_map.description:
Check what each option of {entity_id} should become. Suggested by name; change anything. Options keep your exact wording as the mode name.

**Mirror to old input_select** is a temporary migration aid: Home Modes writes the matching option of the primary mode to the input_select on every mode change (one direction only), so old automations keep working while you move them. Turn it off when you are done.

**Mirror overlays** (off by default) also writes the option of an active overlay such as Guest. If two overlays are active, the one switched on last wins. When the overlay ends, the primary's option is written again.

data.mirror_to_old_input_select: Mirror to old input_select (temporary migration aid)

import_confirm.title: Preview

user_rule_edit.title: What may {user} pick?
user_rule_edit.description: With « Only the modes below », {user} sees only those modes on the cards, and any other change is refused.

notify_add_details.title: Add a notification rule
notify_add_details.description:
Message and title are optional: leave them empty for a standard text. Templates can use to_name, from_name, user, time and more (see the Notifications page in the documentation).

**Two kinds of targets.** Notify entities are the current style: phones from the Companion app and integrations that already moved over. Notify services are the older style that many integrations still only offer (for example notify groups, Telegram, email). A phone appears in both lists: pick it once, in either list.

Phones get their own Android channels (HM_ModeChanges, HM_Alerts, HM_Guests); on iOS they are grouped by the same names.

mode.description: The role id (for example night) or the name of an enabled primary mode.

override.description: Start a manual override. Defaults to on when a user makes the call and off for automations and scripts without a user.

set_overlay.name: Set overlay
set_overlay.description: Turns an overlay mode (Guest, Do not disturb) on or off.

overlay.name: Overlay
overlay.description: The role id (for example guest) or the name of an overlay mode.

active.name: Active
active.description: Whether the overlay should be on.

revert.name: Revert
revert.description: Goes back to the previous primary mode.

set_temporary.name: Set temporary mode
set_temporary.description: Sets a mode and returns to the previous mode when the time is up.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The role id or name of an enabled primary mode.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the temporary mode lasts.

set_auto.name: Set auto
set_auto.description: Clears the override and re-evaluates the auto-rules immediately.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Delete all entries of the history log (administrators only).

import_input_select.name: Import from input_select
import_input_select.description: Suggests how the options of an old input_select map to Home Modes roles and returns a preview, the automations, scripts and template helpers that reference it, and replacement snippets. Nothing is written unless confirm is true. Your automations, helpers and YAML are never edited.

entity_id.name: Input select
entity_id.description: The input_select that holds your old house mode.

mapping.name: Mapping
mapping.description: Optional. Maps an option (exact text) to a role id, "custom" (new custom mode) or "skip". Options you leave out use the suggestion.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Apply the previewed mapping (renames or enables roles, adds custom modes). Off: preview only.

mirror.name: Mirror to old input_select
mirror.description: Temporary migration aid: write the matching option of the primary mode to the input_select on every mode change (one direction only). Only used together with confirm.

mirror_overlays.name: Mirror overlays
mirror_overlays.description: Also write the option of an active overlay (for example Guest) to the input_select. Off by default. Leave out to keep the stored setting. Only used together with confirm.
